37dd986a: 
 ;Protocol to edit a file using FileMan input templates.
 ;Assumes protocol DFN is the IEN of the entry to be edited.
 ;
 ;Used in the VistA Medical Distribution System - Application Guide
 ;menu option [VMED MNU-ARCHIVING [VMED PACKAGE TOOLS] VMED ON IT ARCHIVING.
c9ecb130: ;Call ^DIE to invoke FileMan editor.
f38e08fb: ;Set values for FileMan variables and call FileMan code to perform input template checks.
405b84c3: ;If the entry already exists, set DE(1) to the value of the .01 field.
2a91becf: ;Kill temporary variables and quit.
f300289d: ;Write prompt at column DL+DL-2.
62cf2083: ;Quit if input is not required.
1bb34c4a: ;Write output code based on FileMan specifications.
a0df5bc6: ;If field is computed or word-processing, jump to FileMan's RW^DIR2.
c49974aa: ;If input is not allowed, display 'No Editing' message.
45130cfc: ;Read user input, time out if no response. Set DTOUT=U for timeout. Sound alert if input is invalid.
25e5534e: ;Quit after user input is read.
35ec2706: Increment the stack pointer.
9aac5ad7: Branch based on the stack pointer.
00acd609: Go to the RE label if there is a value for the current stack entry, otherwise do W and TR.
af16d1a5: Handle empty input based on various conditions.
4fe99423: Check for help request, branch to QS if so, otherwise check for up-arrow and branch to ^DIE17 if found.
fe9083a7: Check for '@' input and branch to Z^DIE2 if found.
3ecf965c: Handle space input for data dictionaries with default values.
cd165416: Handle input matching for various input types and conditions.
ddfdd786: Look for matching input in the DU string.
a2de612a: Display any remaining part of the DU string and update X.
78004b83: If the user chooses to exit the input, go to the next line.
1f9f95f3: If the user is not entering a number, go to the next line. If the length of the decimal part of the number is greater than 24, clear the input and go to the next line.
5a460c5e: If a comma is included in the input, remove leading and trailing zeros, and convert to a number if there is no decimal part.
f2a8785e: Execute any additional code associated with this field and clear the temporary storage variable YS.
f877bd34: Clear temporary variables, store the user input in the DG array if it is not undefined, and store it in the ^DISV global if the 'd' flag is present in DV. Then go to the next line.
44ca0f47: If the data dictionary is present for the current field, branch to label Z^DIE17.
376295e2: Set X to a bad value indicator.
05dcbf67: Enter the QS label; set DZ=X, execute routine D, call QQ^DIEQ, and go to label B.
a6f3c94c: Set D to the current field number, DQ(DQ) to the learned value with pieces for label, value, user value, word-processing value, and execute string. Return.

b3a45790: If there is no data dictionary for the current field, execute O, then go to RD if not input transform, A if input transform and value is not word-processing, or X if just @ transform. Set X=Y and go to N.
1ffc65d6: Set DG=DV, Y=DE(DQ), X=DU. If a transform is defined for this field, execute it and go to RP.
f4e79e0a: If DG is pointer type and file has a zero node, set X to .01 value. If file has entry for value in Y, set Y to value and X,DG to corresponding DD value,specifier. Execute recursively.
ef90097f: If DG is variable pointer, entry exists, and file has DD node, set DG and X similarly and recurse. If DG is date validator, execute it.
880bde01: If DG is set selector, find next piece of X delimited by Y and store in Y.
